output.body:
Dear {vendor} team,

We are writing to dispute charges on our hosting account under {agreement}.

The agreement states: "{cap_clause}" Our prior monthly fee was {prior_monthly}, so the highest renewal fee the agreement permits is {max_allowed_monthly}. Your renewal raised the monthly fee to {charged_monthly}, an increase of {actual_increase_pct}, which exceeds the {cap_pct} cap.

The following invoices reflect the overcharge: {invoices}. The overcharge is {overcharge_monthly} per month, or {overcharged_to_date} to date.

Please issue a credit for {overcharged_to_date}, and send a corrected bill that applies the monthly fee capped at {max_allowed_monthly} for all future invoices in this renewal term. Please confirm once the credit and corrected billing are in place.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
{sender}
